label: Mastodon
description: Read your verified account and authored status metadata without post content

operations.name: verify_credentials
operations.description: Read the protected token verification endpoint and return only its opaque current actor ID. Public account/status success alone cannot prove authentication.

operations.name: get_account
operations.description: Independently read your verified account's scalar IDs, counts and raw dates. Reverify the user token before returning output.

operations.name: list_statuses
operations.description: Read one current actor page with exclude_reblogs and exclude_replies fixed true. The latter excludes replies to other accounts; self replies may remain. Content and nested data are never returned.

operations.name: get_status
operations.description: Require the exact status ID in your current configured catalog page, then independently read its metadata and reverify the actor. Use documented cursors to select older pages.
